# Waymark 0.2.5

Download **Waymark-0.2.5-Setup.exe** and run it once. Waymark includes its tracking worker; no GitHub account, Python, GitHub CLI or separate updater is needed. Existing Npcap tracking requirements are unchanged.

Subsequent releases can be downloaded and installed in Waymark. Downloads show a percentage bar. **Install and restart** saves a local recovery snapshot, closes tracking safely, installs the verified update and reopens Waymark. Check on launch is enabled by default; automatic downloading and installation are opt-in in Settings.

Your character data, pets, completion history, settings, window positions, pins and routes remain in their existing local data folder. Update recovery snapshots are stored in its `backups/update-*` folders. The installer does not remove this data.

The portable ZIP remains available for manual use. Users on 0.2.4 need to run this installer once to obtain the new in-app updater.

This is an unofficial AION 2 preview. Map/collection tracking has the same limitations as 0.2.4. Installer/update signatures authenticate Waymark releases; a Windows publisher certificate is not yet configured, so Windows may still display its usual reputation prompt.
